patterns.note: Content is presented in wide, centered blocks against a full-bleed dark background, creating a strong visual anchor for text.
Headings use an extremely bold, uppercase sans-serif font in white, contrasting sharply with smaller, lighter-weight body text and neon green accents.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and vibrant neon green is used consistently for backgrounds, text, and interactive elements.
A dynamic, animated 3D grid pattern, rendered with WebGL/Three.js, serves as a persistent background element that subtly shifts and moves as the user scrolls down the page.
The primary navigation bar transitions from transparent over the hero to a fixed position with a solid dark background and a subtle border/shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Sections are clearly delineated by large, bold headings and ample vertical spacing, often featuring a short introductory label in neon green.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-page, continuously animated 3D grid background using WebGL/Three.js, which provides a dynamic visual texture that moves independently of the foreground content during scroll.

The main navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero content, then becomes sticky at the top of the viewport and gains a solid dark background and a subtle bottom border/shadow after a short scroll distance.
Content sections are introduced with large, high-contrast headings and supporting body text, maintaining a generous vertical rhythm to enhance readability against the dark, animated background.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, extremely bold uppercase hero heading (~4-5x body) with subsequent large, bold headings and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all interactive elements and containers feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clear hierarchy.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, full-page animated 3D grid background, rendered with WebGL/Three.js, which gives the site a highly dynamic and modern feel. This, combined with the stark neon green and black color scheme, creates a unique, high-tech aesthetic.
